sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 273 stars, MIT, pushed 2026-07-25, homepage sahithvibudhi.github.io/vibe-tree; latest release v0.2.0 (2026-07-24).

sources.title: VibeTree README
sources.locator: whole file: Features, Quick start, Worktree hooks, Security, Roadmap
sources.finding: Parallel worktree agents with persistent terminals, diff view, hooks, scheduler, desktop notifications, IDE open, browser/phone PWA with QR pairing, optional password auth, MIT.

sources.title: VibeTree architecture
sources.locator: Unified backend, Terminal session lifecycle, Authentication, Build
sources.finding: One server core embedded by Electron and run standalone; deterministic per-worktree PTY session IDs; sessions survive client disconnect and are reaped after idle timeout (default 24h); auth modes.

sources.title: Docker setup
sources.finding: `npm run deploy` builds and runs the server and web UI in a container on a VM or EC2; ports 3000/3002.

sources.title: VibeTree project site
sources.finding: Free and open source, bring your own agent subscriptions, no cloud component and no telemetry; macOS (dmg), Windows (exe) and Linux (AppImage/deb) downloads; fleet status, changes dock, persistent sessions, CLI, phone PWA, hooks, presets.

sources.title: VibeTree v0.2.0 release
sources.finding: Release notes list one backend everywhere, fleet status with a ding, browser preview, changes dock with send-note-to-agent, PWA, agent presets, vibetree CLI and worktree hooks; assets are macOS arm64/x64 dmg and zip, Windows Setup.exe, Linux AppImage and deb.

sources.title: Electron builder config
sources.finding: macOS dmg+zip (x64, arm64), Windows NSIS x64, Linux AppImage and deb x64; publish null (no auto-update feed).

sources.title: Server REST API
sources.finding: REST routes for config, auth login/logout/QR, devices, agent states, shell sessions, git worktrees/status/diff/add/remove, fs list, project discovery/config/validate.

sources.title: Server WebSocket API
sources.finding: shell:start/write/resize/status/get-buffer/terminate/get-agent-states and git:worktree:list/status/diff/diff:staged/worktree:add/remove messages; sessions persist when a connection closes.

sources.title: vibetree CLI
sources.finding: `vibetree worktrees list|add|remove`, `status`, `run <branch> ["prompt"]` with --server/--token/--project/--agent/--delay; uses the same REST and WebSocket APIs as the web app.

sources.title: Git utilities
sources.finding: `git worktree add -b <branch> ../<project>-<branch>` runs post-create hook; removal runs pre-remove hook, `git worktree remove --force` and `git branch -D`.

sources.title: Server config
sources.finding: HOST default 0.0.0.0, PORT 3002, AUTH_REQUIRED, VIBETREE_USERNAME/PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET default dev secret, SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS default 24h, ALLOW_INSECURE_LAN.

sources.title: Auth service
sources.finding: QR pairing generates a short-lived token exchanged for a device JWT with 7-day expiry; devices can be listed and revoked over REST.

sources.title: Agent state tracker
sources.finding: Derives idle/working/needs-input/done per terminal session from PTY traffic and user Enter input; broadcast to clients.

sources.title: Agent activity patterns
sources.finding: Regex heuristics for completion (send prompt) and questions ([Y/n], Do you want to proceed?) in terminal output; tuned to Claude Code style prompts.

sources.title: Desktop notification manager
sources.finding: Native Electron notifications for completed and question states per worktree, with macOS permission handling.

sources.title: Terminal command scheduler
sources.finding: Desktop renderer dialog that queues a command to send to a terminal after a delay, once or repeating; state cached in the renderer and listed per worktree.

sources.title: Project config
sources.finding: `.vibetree/config.json` stores a per-project agentCommand preset that the UI and CLI launch.

sources.title: IDE detector
sources.finding: Desktop detects VS Code and Cursor and opens a worktree path in them.
